title: SingingEvent
description: Per-participant singing detection sample or edge event (Task 2). Owned by Person B. Person C (Task 3) consumes these to open/close Signals.

participant_id.description: Who this classification belongs to (Task 1 audio track attribution).

timestamp_ms.description: Clock aligned with the audio track (room-relative or epoch ms).

is_singing.description: True when the detector believes the participant is singing at timestamp_ms.

confidence.description: Detector confidence in the is_singing decision.

kind.description: sample = periodic poll (100–250ms). singing_started / singing_stopped are edge events so Task 3 does not have to poll.

pitch_hz.description: Optional diagnostic: estimated F0 at this frame, or null if unvoiced.
